patterns: Direct inscription-ruler items dominate: Allahabad Pillar = Samudragupta (APPSC 2025), Bhitari = Skandagupta vs Hunas, Eran = first Sati, Mehrauli = Chandra.
APPSC-G1 2024 two-statement trap: Saka victory is Chandragupta II, not Chandragupta I; southern conquests not annexed.
Title one-liners recur: Prithivyah Pratham Veer, Lichchhavi-dauhitra, Param Bhagavata (all Samudragupta).
AP tilt: Dakshinapatha kings in Andhra (Hastivarman of Vengi, Mahendragiri of Pishtapura).
App uses many match-list and multi-statement items; PYQs are mostly single-fact.
